deliverables.text: Website Design & Build — Full custom site on Astro + Cloudflare Pages
SEO Foundation — On-page optimization, schema, sitemap, GSC setup
Blog Setup — Structure, categories, initial posts, keyword strategy
Social Media Setup — Profiles, branding, content templates, initial content
Launch Checklist — Final QA, redirects, domain, analytics, go-live

package_details.monthly_audit: This is a full-launch project, not a monthly retainer. All deliverables are scoped for the initial launch of sunbrightrecovery.org.
package_details.blog_or_seo: SEO setup includes on-page optimization for all core pages, structured data (schema), XML sitemap, Google Search Console configuration, and keyword strategy for addiction recovery in Northern California.
package_details.site_hour: Website built on Astro 4.x with Tailwind CSS, deployed via Cloudflare Pages. Auto-deploys on push to main — changes go live in ~30 seconds.
package_details.quarterly_report: A launch performance report will be delivered 90 days after the site goes live to measure early GSC data, ranking progress, and next-step recommendations.
package_details.overage: Scope changes or additions beyond the agreed deliverables are billed at the standard project rate. Contact Kandy to discuss.

items.title: Homepage Design & Build
items.why: Full homepage with all 13 sections built and in client review. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages at preview URL.

items.title: Programs Page — Residential, IOP, Sober Living
items.why: Core service page. Each program needs its own section with clear descriptions, eligibility, and CTAs. Target keywords for each program type.

items.title: About Page — Linda Spyres + Team
items.why: E-E-A-T is critical for YMYL health/recovery sites. Founder credentials, 20+ years experience, and team bios build trust with both users and Google.

items.title: Admissions Page + Contact Forms
items.why: Multiple CTAs on homepage link to /admissions. This page needs a clear intake form, HIPAA language, and phone number prominently displayed.

items.title: Donate & Get Involved Page
items.why: Critical for nonprofit fundraising. Tax-deductible donation info, Adopt-a-Space tiers, volunteer options, and partner outreach — all referenced in the homepage CTA.

items.title: FAQ Page
items.why: 7 FAQs on the homepage expand to a full FAQ page. Targets question-based searches ('how long is rehab', 'what does detox cost') and qualifies for FAQ rich results in SERPs.

items.title: Privacy Policy + Terms of Service
items.why: HIPAA compliance requirement for any site collecting intake information. Google quality raters check for trust pages on health sites — required before launch.

items.title: Keyword Research — Northern CA Recovery
items.why: Full keyword map for addiction treatment in Tehama County and Northern California. Identifies target keywords for every page and the blog strategy.

items.title: On-Page SEO — All Pages
items.why: Title tags, meta descriptions, H1/H2 hierarchy, image alt text, and internal linking applied to every page before launch.

items.title: Schema Markup — Organization + MedicalBusiness
items.why: Structured data for a nonprofit recovery center signals credibility to Google. MedicalBusiness schema with accreditation, founder, location, and service area.

items.title: Google Search Console + Sitemap Setup
items.why: GSC must be configured at launch so Google begins crawling and indexing immediately. XML sitemap submitted, coverage monitored.

items.title: Google Analytics 4 Setup
items.why: GA4 configured before launch so all traffic is measured from day one. Goal tracking for phone clicks, form submissions, and admissions inquiries.

items.title: Google Business Profile
items.why: Critical for local 'near me' searches for rehab and recovery in Red Bluff. Full profile with address, hours, services, photos, and Linda's credentials.

items.title: Blog Structure Setup
items.why: Categories, author profiles, and post templates configured. Blog needs to be crawlable and linked from the main nav before the first post goes live.

items.title: First 2 Blog Posts Written & Published
items.why: Launch with 2 posts so the blog isn't empty on day one. Posts target high-intent local keywords ('addiction treatment red bluff ca', 'residential rehab northern california').

items.title: Blog Content Calendar — 6 Months
items.why: Consistent publishing is an SEO signal. 6-month calendar of keyword-targeted topics written and scheduled so Linda always knows what's coming.

items.title: Facebook Page Setup + Branding
items.why: Facebook is critical for rehab/recovery audiences. Full profile setup with brand assets, cover image, services, and about section. First 5 posts published.

items.title: Instagram Setup + Brand Templates
items.why: Instagram reach for recovery content (motivation, education, facility photos). Branded templates created for recurring post types so content is consistent.

items.title: Social Content Templates — 10 Reusable Formats
items.why: 10 Canva templates matching brand palette (navy, gold, cream) for Linda's team to use ongoing. Templates for motivational quotes, program spotlights, FAQ cards, and donation calls.

items.title: Initial Content Batch — 2 Weeks Scheduled
items.why: Launch with 2 weeks of posts already scheduled on both platforms so social presence is active from day one.

items.title: Pre-Launch QA — Full Site Review
items.why: Every link, form, page, and mobile breakpoint tested. Spelling, legal disclaimers, HIPAA language, and image licenses verified.

items.title: Domain Cutover — sunbrightrecovery.org
items.why: DNS pointed to Cloudflare Pages. SSL verified, www redirect configured, old domain (if any) 301-redirected.

items.title: Post-Launch Indexing Check
items.why: GSC crawl requested, initial indexing monitored, any coverage errors resolved within 48 hours of launch.

messages.text:
Welcome to your Phoenix Method client portal, Linda! This is your home base for the Sunbright Recovery website project — you can check progress on every deliverable, see what's coming up in the content calendar, and track our build phases in real time.

Where we are: the homepage is fully built and in review. It covers all 13 sections — hero, programs, about, what we treat, your daily schedule, the donation/volunteer block, FAQ, and footer. You can view the preview at the Cloudflare Pages URL Kandy sent you.

Next step: send back your feedback on the homepage and we'll begin building the inner pages — Programs, About (with your bio), Admissions, and the Donate page. Once all pages are built, we'll apply the full SEO setup and get the blog and social media off the ground before your domain goes live.

Checking in as we head into July. The homepage is built and deployed at the preview URL. As soon as we hear back on your homepage feedback, we move straight into the inner pages — Programs, About, Admissions, and Donate. Per the build schedule, those pages are the July priority, followed by SEO setup on all pages and the first two blog posts. We're on track for an August launch if we keep momentum. Reach out anytime with feedback or questions — we're ready to move when you are.

August update — this is your launch month! The homepage has been built and deployed at the preview URL since June, and we're ready to move as soon as we hear your feedback on it. August priorities per the build schedule: inner pages (Programs, About, Admissions, Donate), SEO foundation on all pages, first two blog posts, social media profile setup, pre-launch QA, and the domain cutover to sunbrightrecovery.org. We need your homepage feedback to kick off the inner page builds — please send that over whenever you're ready and we'll hit the ground running.
